title: Cabin O2 partial pressure outside 19.5-23.5 kPa
body: If cabin ppO2 drops below 19.5 kPa or exceeds 23.5 kPa, isolate the affected segment, close hatches per ISS Caution & Warning. ppO2 < 17.0 kPa is loss-of-life threshold; mandate immediate crew donning of EMU PLSS or transfer to safe haven (Soyuz/Crew Dragon).
citation: ISS Generic Operational Flight Rules ALL-FR-ECLSS-101 (NASA)

title: Cabin CO2 partial pressure
body: ppCO2 should remain below 0.7 kPa (5 mmHg) for nominal ops. ppCO2 > 1.0 kPa requires CDRA mode change or backup LiOH activation. ppCO2 > 1.5 kPa requires crew action and ground concurrence.
citation: ISS Generic Operational Flight Rules ALL-FR-ECLSS-102

title: CDRA bed switch failure
body: If CDRA fails to perform bed switch within 7 hours, switch to backup CDRA. If both CDRAs unavailable, activate Vozdukh (Russian segment) and LiOH canisters. Reduce crew metabolic load by deferring exercise.

title: Bus voltage below 113 VDC
body: If primary 120 VDC main bus drops below 113 VDC, automatic load-shed sequence engages: shed Group 4 (non-critical experiments), then Group 3 (lighting), then Group 2 (active thermal). Group 1 (life support, attitude, comms) is NEVER shed automatically.
citation: ISS Power System Specification SSP-30482 + Operational Rules
